title: Speculative enquiry: junior site engineer (Central Coast or Hunter NSW)
location: Berkeley Vale NSW (Central Coast and Hunter projects)
content_text: Byrne Civil Group careers page (checked 14 Oct 2026 AEDT). 'Looking to advance your career in civil construction? ... if you cannot see any advertised roles that suit, but you're interested in working for Byrne, please contact us at any time to express interest!' Expression of interest roles listed: Site Manager/Foreman, Formwork/Carpenter, Site Engineer, Project Manager, Operators, Pipelayer, Civil Construction Workers, Civil Construction Apprentice. Undergraduate Program for university students. 'If you are interested in being part of the team at Byrne Civil Group then please email through a resume to careers@byrnecivil.com or fill out the application form below.' A testimonial from Ryan Coughlan says he started as a site engineer and progressed to project manager. Services page: Government Infrastructure, Subdivision Construction, Commercial Developments, Sewer, Water, Stormwater, Structural Concrete, Hydraulic Services, Plant Hire, Licensed Asbestos Removal; 'Transformative Projects Across New South Wales' including Johns Road Residential Subdivision, Albert Warner Drive Residential Subdivision, Bulga Culverts (Singleton Council), Marine Drive Road Reconstruction and Slope Stabilisation and Sturgeon Street Road Construction (Port Stephens Council), Palmdale Road Extension. Office: 1/6 Corella Close, Berkeley Vale NSW 2261. No dated vacancy advert is shown, so this is a speculative enquiry.
apply_instructions: Email a resume to careers@byrnecivil.com (published on https://byrnecivil.com/careers/) or use the careers form.
supported_contributions: Site inspections, quality checks, drawing reviews and daily crew coordination from Philippines project-in-charge and field engineer work 2019 to 2020
Site reports, material records, procurement tracking and progress reports from residential subdivision finishing works
Road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, plus Before You Dig Australia enquiries, from the Advanced Diploma
